title: Homework set: percentages and ratio
subject: Mathematics
unit: Spring 1: Revision cycle 1: Number, algebra, sequences, graphs
source: Written for mathematics/y11 lesson 57 (Complete the portal's percentages and ratio set (8 questions) and log any errors in your repair list.)
intro: 8 questions. Calculator allowed. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and add any errors to your repair list.

questions.q: In a sale, a coat costs £68 after a 15% reduction. Work out the price before the sale.
A town has 12 000 people. The population grows by 4% each year. Work out the population after 3 years, to the nearest whole number.
A price rises from £45 to £54. Work out the percentage increase.
In a club the ratio of adults to children is 3 : 8. There are 40 more children than adults. How many people are in the club?
x : y = 3 : 4 and y : z = 6 : 5. Find x : y : z in its simplest form.
